name: AccordTrace
description: Portable tamper-evident proof records, cryptographic Agent Passports, defensive security signals, bilateral reputation evidence, and least-privilege capability authorization for AI-agent workflows.

resources.name: AccordTrace REST API
intents: discover marketplace security trust and gateway APIs

resources.name: AccordTrace Agent Security
resources.notes: v0.1 verifies Ed25519 Passport key control and security signals. Identity, marketplace ownership, payment claims, and public reputation are not implied.

resources.name: AccordTrace Reputation Evidence
intents: sign accepted or disputed work claim
resources.notes: v0.1 reports bilateral cryptographic evidence and counterparty diversity. It does not issue a numeric trust score, prove legal identity, independently verify payment settlement, or custody funds.

resources.name: AccordTrace Capability Gateway
resources.notes: v0.1 is a policy-decision service. The caller's runtime or gateway must enforce allow/deny before using real credentials or invoking tools. Leases contain no target-system credentials.
